energy_surrogate: normal kinetic energy only: 0.5 * mass * vertical_speed^2

controlled_ditching_class.label: Controlled ditching class
controlled_ditching_class.status: ASSUMPTION constrained by published controlled-ditching examples
controlled_ditching_class.basis: 0.5 m/s lower sensitivity bound; 1.1 m/s Froude-scaled example; 1.5 m/s published class maximum

us1549_observed_contact.label: Flight 1549 observed contact
us1549_observed_contact.status: SOURCE measurement applied to MH370 mass as a cross-aircraft analogue
us1549_observed_contact.basis: NTSB 12.5 ft/s water-contact descent rate; A320 kinematics, not a Boeing 777 model

partially_arrested_bridge.label: Partially arrested sensitivity bridge
partially_arrested_bridge.status: ASSUMPTION-only bridge; not an inferred event probability
partially_arrested_bridge.basis: Spans the Flight 1549 observed contact rate to the lower Holland 00:19:37 bound

holland_unarrested_bound.label: Holland unarrested bound
holland_unarrested_bound.status: ASSUMPTION over SOURCE bounds; triangular density centred on the retained timing-model median
holland_unarrested_bound.basis: 13,800–25,300 ft/min at 00:19:37, converted exactly; triangular density is a declared sensitivity prior

f35_centred.label: F-35-centred sensitivity prior
f35_centred.status: ASSUMPTION centred on a SOURCE order-of-magnitude anchor; not an empirical MH370 posterior

loguniform_control.label: Log-uniform coupling control
loguniform_control.status: ASSUMPTION-only broad control; equal density per decade

aircraft_mass_basis: Actual 9M-MRO zero-fuel weight on the final loadsheet; used as a fuel-exhaustion impact-mass surrogate, not a measured mass at 00:19 UTC.
